capabilities: capture short memos from a dedicated view without leaving it
filter memos by text and YAML tags
browse memo activity in a year-based heatmap and filter by day
run shuffled random-review sessions over stored memos
configure the vault folder where memos are stored
extras: Manifest is flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states the plugin works fully locally with no network requests, accounts, or payment.
problem: Capturing a fleeting thought in Obsidian normally means creating and naming a full note, and old short notes rarely resurface on their own.
summary: Quick-capture memo tool that stores short thoughts as timestamped Markdown files and resurfaces them via a timeline, heatmap, and random review.
